Going to point out here that natural earthquakes can be anything from emergent to extremely sharp for Pn.

Pn and Lg aren't usually picked from the same component of a seismic station either. They partition differently onto the three components of the instrument.

I am looking at MKAR data from all earthquakes in this region to try to identify the 3 events displayed on the image shown. The second of the events shown has low amplitude Lg. I am interested to imagine how the P/Lg ratio changes for earthquakes of lower magnitude.
